help_stores: Each store connects to one {brand} workspace separately. Connecting opens {brand} in a new step where you choose the workspace and what the assistant may read.
text_confirm_disconnect: Disconnect this store from {brand}? The assistant will stop reading products and orders immediately.
help_app_url: The address you use to open your {brand} dashboard, for example https://app.example.com.
help_api_url: Only needed when your {brand} API is served from a different address than the dashboard.
entry_orders: Let the assistant read customers' own orders
help_orders: Only for the signed-in customer who asks, only their orders in this store, and only while they are still signed in.
entry_reviews: Let the assistant read approved reviews
text_scope_installation: Any customer account of this OpenCart installation (OpenCart default)
text_scope_registration: Only accounts registered in the connected store
help_customer_scope: OpenCart shares customer accounts across all stores of one installation. Orders are always limited to the connected store.
text_unsupported: This extension supports OpenCart {supported} on PHP 8.1 or newer. This shop runs OpenCart %s.
error_permission: You do not have permission to change the {brand} extension.
error_csrf: This form has expired. Reload the page and try again.
error_app_url: Enter and save the {brand} address first.
error_https: The store address must use https:// to connect.
error_storage: The extension could not create its key file in OpenCart's storage folder. Check that the storage folder is writable.
error_test_throttled: Please wait half a minute before checking again.
text_callback_success: This store is now connected to {brand}.
text_callback_failed: The connection could not be completed
text_callback_return: You can close this tab and return to the OpenCart admin.
